components.title: Vocabulary Review
components.subtitle: Flip each card to reveal the definition, then move on to the next word.

components.title: Tip
components.description: Try to recall the meaning before flipping. Saying the word out loud can help it stick.

cards.back: Lasting for a very short time. e.g. "The beauty of the sunset was ephemeral."
Present, appearing, or found everywhere. e.g. "Smartphones are now ubiquitous."
Truthful and straightforward; frank. e.g. "She gave a candid account of events."
Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
Able to recover quickly from difficulties; tough.
Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing.
Dealing with things sensibly and realistically, based on practical considerations.
Well-meaning and kindly; generous in helping others.
Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
Holding firmly to something; persistent and determined.
